description: Zephyr RTOS driver implementation for ITE IT8XXX2 watchdog timer, including configuration, setup, feeding, disabling, and interrupt handling.

methods.name: wdt_it8xxx2_install_timeout
methods.description: Installs a watchdog timeout configuration, validating parameters and storing callback.

methods.name: wdt_it8xxx2_setup
methods.description: Configures and starts the watchdog timer with specified options.

methods.name: wdt_it8xxx2_feed
methods.description: Reloads the watchdog timer to prevent expiration.

methods.name: wdt_it8xxx2_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for watchdog pre-warning timer, calls callback and manages warning timer.

methods.name: wdt_it8xxx2_init
methods.description: Initializes the watchdog device, sets default configurations, and connects IRQ.
